retained.d047_verbatim: The F12 target contract MUST cover opponent-adjusted, interacting two-team efficiency structures: per-side offensive/defensive strength components where each game's realized efficiency is read relative to the opponent's concurrent strength (joint/iterative adjustment permitted), combined across the two teams (off_A x def_B and off_B x def_A) rather than single-team averages.
retained.mechanism: Raw per-team scoring averages are contaminated by strength of schedule; each side's score is an interaction of one team's offense with the other's defense. Jointly estimated, ridge-shrunk per-side offensive and defensive strength components, refit strictly-lagged at each cutoff, read each prior game's realized efficiency relative to the opponent's concurrent strength and recombine across the matchup (off_home vs def_away and off_away vs def_home) - recovering exactly what a single-team average discards (SOURCE_5 audit item 1: the opponent tag on every observation).
retained.provenance_detail: USER_DIRECTED (D047 p1, quoted above); SOURCE_2 C2-2 (ridge bilinear, sum-to-zero identified); SOURCE_5 M1 (schedule-deconvolved two-way ridge); SOURCE_1 SS1's observation equation (pts_home = m + off_H - def_A + h) is the same interacting structure in state-space clothing - its structural half merges here, its dynamics half merges into SC10. Partial: SOURCE_3 F3-3 component (d) named one-pass opponent adjustment as a combination component. Independent-source tally: 3 full + 1 partial; the directed label never counts toward the tally.
retained.estimand_rationale: E2/E3 first: margin is exactly the strength difference, and schedule asymmetry between the two clubs is what an unadjusted average cannot see (both proposing sources agree). E1 registered because the interacting structure moves both sides' expected points and the directed mandate targets the score family broadly; acknowledged as the weakest of the three elements and it taxes the family accordingly - a deliberate, declared choice.
retained.input_inventory: Strictly-prior team-game rows from owned committed data (master_team lineage: side points, opponent points), opponent identity, home/away designation, season - all schedule-identity columns as-of-cutoff; owned strictly-prior possession counts for per-100-possession scale; the frozen verified pace ingredient team_possession_prior_v1.projected_team_off_possessions for recombination to points scale. No market fields, no availability data, no same-game realized information.
retained.functional_form: Per side, fit on strictly-prior rows at each cutoff: pts_ij = mu + off_i - def_j + eta*home_ij + eps, ridge penalty on (off, def) with pinned selection rule; optionally per-possession scale recombined with the frozen pace ingredient. E2 = (off_H - def_A) - (off_A - def_H) + eta; E1 = sum of side means; E3 via the declared link on E2 with train-years-only dispersion. Fitted: 2T team effects (T = active teams, ridge-shrunk, effective df much smaller), mu, eta. Null-granted composite ingredients enter the design as regressors (containment).
retained.identification_constraint: REGISTERED (mandatory, F12 4.4 carry-forward): off and def components are identified only up to a shared constant; sum-to-zero constraints Sigma off_i = Sigma def_i = 0 over active teams within the estimation window, with the level absorbed by mu. The home term eta is identified as the only matchup-invariant asymmetric term. Declared in the card, never left implicit.
retained.covariance_obligation: This arm forecasts the two sides separately: per-side residual variances, home/away residual covariance and corr(e_home, e_away) are first-class receipted outputs per contract section 5 (bottomup_3pt_channel_v1 precedent binding).
retained.expected_failure_mode: Ratings and the null-granted shrunk EWMAs converge to nearly the same numbers by mid-season, so the increment lives in the first ~10-12 games per season - a small slice of the pooled metric (SOURCE_2's own warning). Cycle-1 caveat carried honestly per D047 p4: A26 showed SOS-adjustment null ON PACE; opponent adjustment for EFFICIENCY is untested and is exactly this arm's question.

This is a FRESH registration on the score-family estimands; no cycle-1 evidence is carried as support, and the cycle-1 near-miss may never be cited toward this arm's promotion. retained.mechanism: Early-season games systematically deviate from projected scoring levels by a transient that decays with each team's completed-game count: conditioning, new-system integration, and rotation settling produce a level deviation with decaying magnitude that a static or fixed-decay composite cannot represent. Re-registration of cycle-1 A07 (delta * exp(-n/tau), tau = 5 pinned, team clock) on the score estimands.
retained.provenance_detail: Directed by D047 via D042/D043 carriage. No ideation source proposed the exp(-n/tau) transient form itself (the ideation wave's early-season proposals are initialization/carryover mechanisms, deduplicated into SC03); directed candidates never count toward independent-source tallies.
retained.estimand_rationale: E1 via the SUM form (both teams' transients add on the total); E2 via the DIFFERENTIAL form exp(-n_H/5) - exp(-n_A/5), which is nonzero under staggered schedules (the cycle-1 team-clock property). E3 not registered: any E3 gain is derivative of E2 and would tax the family without independent magnitude (SOURCE_4 economics adopted).
retained.input_inventory: n_i = count of each team's completed same-season games strictly before the cutoff - derivable from as-of-cutoff schedule identity plus completedness of strictly-earlier games (the cycle-1 A07 construction, S8-eligible lineage). Nothing else beyond the null-granted terms.
retained.functional_form: E1 element: null-granted design + delta_sum * (exp(-n_H/5) + exp(-n_A/5)). E2 element: null-granted design + delta_diff * (exp(-n_H/5) - exp(-n_A/5)). tau = 5 carried pinned from the cycle-1 registration (never retuned); one fitted coefficient per element. Direction NOT preregistered (cycle-1 convention); a sign flip across folds kills.

E1 element: null-granted design + beta * g(n) * (carry_total_home + carry_total_away), carry_total = prior-season scoring-environment deviation. One fitted beta per element. Expansion teams: carry = 0 (exact league mean) - full coverage, no predicate. Preserved choice set (charged to the family budget if enabled at S33): the SOURCE_2 learned-decay variant (w0, tau fitted on strictly-prior seasons) - the card freezes ONE form; the 1-df pinned form is this synthesis's recommendation on survival economics (only ~5 season boundaries exist in-universe; SOURCE_2's own failure mode - 'an anecdote wearing a functional form' - argues against fitting the decay).

retained.d047_verbatim: home court (D047 p2, listed among the directed families); contract section 7 renders the directed scope as: home-court structure from a single constant upward.
retained.mechanism: Home-court advantage is not constant: the 2021 attendance-restricted season, the return of full arenas, and secular league change plausibly moved league-wide HCA by 1-2 points across 2021-2026. The null's per-fold-refit intercept tracks this only at fold granularity; a strictly-lagged league-wide HCA estimate tracks it within-fold and within-season. First rung of the directed 'constant upward' ladder.
retained.provenance_detail: Canonical form: SOURCE_4 HCA_DRIFT (1-df pinned-EWMA survival design). Merged league-level components: SOURCE_1 SS8's league state H_t; SOURCE_2 C2-5's mu_h,lg(t) lagged league EWMA; SOURCE_5 M2's lagged league home-advantage constant (shrink target). Independent convergence: 4 of 5 sources proposed home-advantage structure beyond a constant. Directed label additional, not counted.
retained.estimand_rationale: E2 only (SOURCE_4's registration adopted): HCA is a pure margin quantity; the E3 Brier gain from a sub-point HCA correction is too small to justify an element; E1 is untouched by a margin-side mechanism.
retained.input_inventory: League-wide settled home-minus-away margins of strictly-prior games (owned committed data); home/away designation (schedule identity, as-of-cutoff). Nothing else.
retained.functional_form: HCA_lag(t) = EWMA over the league's strictly-prior games of (home pts - away pts), pinned halflife 60 league games, initialized at the earliest fold's train-years mean. E2 element: null-granted design + beta * (HCA_lag(t) - HCA_train_mean), centered so the intercept keeps its meaning. One fitted beta; zero fitted parameters inside the construction.
retained.identification_constraint: REGISTERED (mandatory for directed candidates): no scale indeterminacy - single coefficient on a pinned centered construction; the centering IS the level-separation constraint (the training-constant level stays owned by the null's intercept). Stated affirmatively.
retained.dispute: SC04 and SC11 are the same construction (lagged league EWMA, centered, 1-df) on different channels (home-margin vs total). A merge reading places both in one FAM_S2_LAGGED_LEAGUE_DRIFT. Runs dual-partition: partition A = SC04 in FAM_S2_HOME_COURT with SC05, SC11 alone; partition B = SC04 + SC11 in FAM_S2_LAGGED_LEAGUE_DRIFT, SC05 alone in FAM_S2_HOME_COURT. Stricter governs.
retained.expected_failure_mode: The expanding-fold intercept refit plus any era-adaptivity inside the composite ingredients absorbs nearly all the drift; the residual within-fold signal is a fraction of a point and drowns (SOURCE_4's own honest ranking: the marginal pick).

retained.d047_verbatim: home court (D047 p2); contract section 7: home-court structure from a single constant upward - this arm is the second rung (team dimension).
retained.mechanism: Home advantage differs across franchises (arena environment, dedicated vs shared buildings, travel geometry landing on visitors, expansion-team crowds) and this team-level structure is estimable from each team's strictly-prior home/away scoring splits with hard partial pooling toward the league value - the sample (~20 home games/team/season) demands shrinkage, and tau -> 0 recovers the constant the null already carries, making the null nested and the test clean.
retained.provenance_detail: Merged co-equally: SOURCE_1 SS8 (hierarchical delta_team ~ N(0, tau^2), sum-to-zero); SOURCE_2 C2-5 (empirical-Bayes shrunk delta_team,t); SOURCE_5 M2 (venue-split retention with EB shrinkage to the league constant). Independent convergence: 3 sources on the team-specific component - AND all three independently predicted the same failure mode (shrinkage collapse), which is recorded as convergent skepticism, not suppressed.
retained.estimand_rationale: E2 only: venue effects are margin-shaped almost by definition (SOURCE_5). E3 declined on survival economics - all three proposing sources rate the team-specific component weak; registering its derivative Brier claim would tax the home-court family.
retained.input_inventory: Strictly-prior settled side scores per team split by home/away tag (owned data); home/away designation, venue/franchise identity, season from schedule identity as-of-cutoff. No attendance data (not owned, not needed - the structure absorbs the drift without measuring its cause).
retained.functional_form: h_team = (league HCA term, granted as a pinned lower-order construction identical to SC04's HCA_lag) + delta_team, with delta_team empirical-Bayes shrunk toward 0 given each team's strictly-prior home/away sample (one fitted shrinkage scale tau; team offsets are shrunk estimates, effective df much less than T). E2 element: null-granted design + the delta_team differential term. Fitted: tau plus shrunk offsets.
retained.identification_constraint: REGISTERED (mandatory for directed candidates): delta_team sum to zero across active teams; the league-level HCA component owns the level (granted lower-order term, mirroring SC04's construction). Declared in the card.
retained.expected_failure_mode: tau fits to ~0: no resolvable team-level heterogeneity in six seasons of ~20 home games/team/season - the outcome all three proposing sources independently predicted. The arm then collapses to the constant-plus-drift the null and SC04 already carry, and dies cleanly.

retained.d047_verbatim: rest/travel with the 2024 charter structural break modeled explicitly (D047 p2); contract section 7: era interaction or era restriction - pooling across the break undeclared is a card defect. Cycle-1 nulls bind: rest/schedule/home arms may not target pace mechanisms in the same form; their cycle-2 forms act on scoring.
retained.mechanism: Fatigue (zero days' rest, third game in four days, multi-time-zone travel) degrades scoring efficiency - contested-shot quality, rotation speed, free-throw legs - asymmetrically when one side is rested and one is not. The WNBA schedule is uniquely condensed, and until the 2024 charter-flight program travel was commercial, so the travel component has a structural break at 2024 that must be modeled, not pooled over. Schedule density is absent from pace-x-efficiency strength composites, so the null cannot absorb it. Acts on scoring only; touches no pace construction (cycle-1 retry bound respected).
retained.provenance_detail: Canonical form: SOURCE_4 SCHED_FATIGUE_DIFF (pinned 1-df index, sign pinned, subset-kill design). Merged: SOURCE_1 SS7 (rest/travel on efficiency, differential emphasis); SOURCE_2 C2-4 (contributes the EXPLICIT charter-era interaction the directive requires, plus great-circle travel from a frozen static arena table); SOURCE_3 F3-6 (rest/density modifiers, as-of-cutoff date semantics); SOURCE_5 M3 (rest/congestion differential with pinned bucket map). Independent convergence: 5 of 5 sources - every lens proposed schedule fatigue acting on scoring. The strongest full convergence in the wave alongside early-season initialization.
retained.estimand_rationale: E2/E3 via the fatigue DIFFERENTIAL (a rested team vs a back-to-back road team is the cleanest fatigue signal; SOURCE_4's registration adopted). E1 deliberately NOT registered: the symmetric effect (both teams tired -> lower total) is second-order, its sign is genuinely uncertain (fatigue hurts defense too - SOURCE_2's domain honesty), and it would drag the family.
retained.input_inventory: As-of-cutoff scheduled dates of each team's strictly-prior games and of the current game (closed schedule-identity column set; never as-played - a postponement-updated date never enters, per the contract's precedent); home/away designation and opponent identity; a frozen static arena-location/time-zone table (immutable reference metadata, trivially cutoff-valid); season label for the charter-era interaction. Prior games' realized dates are lagged facts, admissible per the contract's explicit carve-out. No injury, no lineup, no market, no vendor travel data.
retained.functional_form: Pinned fatigue index per team: F = 1.0*1[back-to-back] + 0.5*1[3rd game in 4 days] + 0.25*(time zones crossed since previous game, capped at 3) - all index weights pinned a priori, zero fitted parameters inside the index (SOURCE_4). E2 element: null-granted design + beta*(F_home - F_away) + beta_era*(F_home - F_away)*1[season >= 2024] - the explicit charter-break interaction (SOURCE_2's contribution, mandated by D047). E3 element: identical features in the declared E3 link. Two fitted coefficients per element (beta, beta_era). beta expected negative on the fatigued side; sign pinned in the card.
retained.identification_constraint: REGISTERED (mandatory for directed candidates): no scale or identification indeterminacy - linear coefficients on fully pinned, pre-computable features; the pinned index weights prevent any within-index scale trade. Stated affirmatively.
retained.expected_failure_mode: WNBA effect size smaller than professional-basketball consensus (charter era shortens travel; rotations less minutes-concentrated), leaving pooled Delta inside noise; or the composite's EWMA partially launders recent fatigue through depressed recent scoring, shrinking the orthogonal component (SOURCE_4). The charter era may attenuate the travel term to ~0 post-2024, which the era interaction is designed to expose rather than average away (SOURCE_2).

retained.d047_verbatim: referee-crew effects on totals (D047 p2); contract section 7: referee-crew effects on the totals channel.
retained.mechanism: Officiating crews differ persistently in whistle propensity; a tight crew inflates free-throw volume and stoppage-driven scoring, a loose crew depresses them. A strictly-lagged crew tendency (each crew's historical total-points deviation from the concurrent league level, shrunk hard toward zero), attached to the upcoming game's assigned crew, moves the expected total in a way no team-side aggregate can represent.
retained.provenance_detail: Directed only. NO ideation source proposed referee effects (zero convergence - recorded honestly; the isolated sources had no referee fields named in their input contract's ingredient inventory, so absence of convergence is weak evidence against naturalness here). Directed candidates never count toward independent-source tallies.
retained.estimand_rationale: E1 only, exactly as directed ('effects on totals'). Crew effects on margin should be ~0 by symmetry (crews are not assigned for or against a side); E2/E3 not registered - and that near-zero margin prediction doubles as a cheap self-falsifying integrity receipt, mirroring SOURCE_1's SS6 cross-estimand sanity pattern.
retained.input_inventory: CONDITIONAL - two blocking preconditions, registered rather than assumed: (a) crew-identity columns for historical games must exist in owned committed data (existence not verifiable within this node's read scope); (b) the UPCOMING game's crew assignment is not in the contract's closed schedule-identity column set (scheduled date, opponent/matchup, home/away, season), so consuming it requires S34 adjudication to extend the set AND a receipted cutoff-validity showing assignment is knowable pregame with witnessed provenance - a vendor-asserted retrospective crew record for the prediction-side join fails exactly the P2B standard the contract cites, and the historical (lagged, as-worked) crew tags are admissible lagged facts only for building the tendency, not for the same-game join. If either precondition fails, the arm is NOT REGISTRABLE this cycle and lapses without penalty to the rest of the slate.

retained.mechanism: E3 is a mean divided by a dispersion: P(home win) ~ Phi(E[margin]/sd[margin]). Everyone models the numerator; the denominator is where Brier calibration is won, and the baseline discards the second moment entirely (SOURCE_5 audit item 7). A pregame dispersion model - homoskedastic base plus a small set of preregistered lagged covariates (combined pace prior; lagged team margin dispersion) - converts the same margin mean into better-calibrated probabilities, and Brier punishes variance misspecification more reliably than it rewards marginal resolution.
retained.provenance_detail: Canonical form: SOURCE_3 F3-4 (Phi(mu/sigma(pace)) with train-years-only gamma fit; the CLT pace argument - margin sd grows like sqrt(possessions) while mu grows like possessions). Merged: SOURCE_5 M7 (team volatility covariates; the mu-frozen identification registration; variance-calibration-slope kill); SOURCE_1 SS3 (possession-scaled variance channel; its OT-mixture mean component is noted with dropped F3-7) and SS2's fitted corr(e_home, e_away) machinery (folded in as the covariance component wherever this arm pairs with a side-split mean model); SOURCE_2 C2-7 (style covariates - 3PA-rate terms enter ONLY as an S37-conditional optional covariate, per C2-7's own conditionality; the degraded no-promotion form is the registered base). Independent convergence: 4 of 5 sources proposed modeled margin dispersion for E3 - the wave's third major convergence.
retained.estimand_rationale: E3 alone as the gated element: this mechanism can leave the mean untouched and still move the probability (SOURCE_5). Zero direct claim on E1/E2 MAE, stated plainly (SOURCE_2's discipline). If the arm also emits E1/E2 predictive distributions, CRPS/PIT are sealed secondary endpoints under contract section 5 - never a promotion basis; the K0 emits the same functional form with matched train-years-only dispersion estimation.
retained.input_inventory: The paired margin model's own strictly-lagged prediction path (mu frozen from it); the frozen verified pace ingredient (both sides' projected possessions); each club's strictly-prior margin dispersion (rolling sd of own settled margins, owned data, shrunken); historical strictly-prior OT rates as a small variance inflation (expressly legitimate pregame construction per contract section 1); train-years-only residual variance estimates. S37-conditional optional covariate: lagged 3PA-rate terms, only if promoted from the F13 UNPROVEN inventory - the registered base form does not depend on them.
retained.functional_form: E3 = Phi(mu_hat / sigma_hat_g), mu_hat frozen from the paired mean model (the null-granted composite mean for the K0; the arm's declared mean path for the arm - identical mapping machinery both sides, so Delta isolates the dispersion information). sigma_hat_g^2 = sigma0^2 * exp(gamma1 * z(pace_prior_sum) + gamma2 * z(lagged_margin_sd_sum)) with sigma0, gammas fit train-years-only per fold by Gaussian likelihood on train margin residuals; gamma = 0 recovers the homoskedastic base. Fitted: 3 (sigma0, gamma1, gamma2). p-clipping bounds declared identically for arm and K0 (matched dimension).
retained.identification_constraint: REGISTERED (SOURCE_5 M7's constraint adopted): mean and dispersion trade off in a probability-only fit; mu_hat is FROZEN from the paired mean model and only the sigma parameters are free. Declared in the card.
retained.expected_failure_mode: Matchup-level dispersion differences are small relative to the ~14-point base margin sd; the K0's matched constant train-years sd is not measurably worse, and thin team-level dispersion estimates overfit sigma into the tails where Brier punishes hardest (all four proposing sources' shared warning).

retained.mechanism: Realized margins compress relative to a linear function of strength gap when the gap is large (leads produce bench minutes and slack effort). The null is linear in its granted ingredient columns by construction; a concave transform of the null's own implied gap adds no information but adds exactly the one shape the linear null cannot express - the purest test in the slate of 'the null knows the ingredients but not the geometry' (SOURCE_4).

retained.functional_form: g_hat = the K0's own fitted margin prediction from the null-granted columns (train-fold-fitted, expanding protocol). retained.mechanism: A single-decay level estimator collapses within-window ordering into level: a team that climbed to x and a team flat at x get the same estimate. The spread between short-, medium-, and long-horizon strictly-lagged scoring levels, damped toward the long-run anchor, carries the trend/trajectory information the fixed-decay null-granted ingredients structurally cannot represent (the M-competition damped-trend result transplanted to team scoring).
retained.provenance_detail: Canonical form: SOURCE_3 F3-1 (multi-horizon damped-level spread block, ridge-shrunk toward zero spread - the damping is estimated, not asserted; hosts the null natively). Merged: SOURCE_5 M8 (trailing WLS slope - preserved as an alternative basis in the choice set; its schedule-confound orthogonalization receipt is carried as a kill); SOURCE_1 SS1's dynamics half (fitted adaptation rate - the Kalman gain is the continuous-time generalization of the horizon blend; its own most-likely outcome, innovation-variance collapse to the static null, is this arm's failure mode restated). Independent convergence: 3 of 5 sources proposed recent-form/trend information beyond a static level.
retained.estimand_rationale: Both are sums/differences of team scoring levels; better level-path estimation moves both (SOURCE_3). E3 not registered (derivative).
retained.input_inventory: Own committed strictly-prior team points-for/points-against history; season labels for the prior-season anchor. Nothing same-game, no market, no injury.
retained.functional_form: Per team-side, horizon states L_h at pinned half-lives (short ~ 3-5 games, medium ~ 10-15, long = season-to-date) over strictly-prior games; feature block {L_short - L_long, L_med - L_long, L_prevseason_shrunk} entering the declared head beside the null-granted ingredients, ridge-penalized with prior mean 0 on the spread coefficients (the fitted spread weight IS the damping factor), trained under the declared matched objective. Fitted: <= 4 ridge-shrunk spread coefficients per element. Choice set (one basis frozen at S33, charged to the family budget if both retained): the M8 trailing-slope basis.
retained.identification_constraint: REGISTERED: spreads are defined relative to L_long, and the level is owned by the null-granted ingredient columns plus intercept - the spread block is level-free by construction (centering constraint declared).
retained.expected_failure_mode: Collinearity with the null-granted ingredients: if the frozen composite's smoothing sits near the optimal single half-life, the horizon spreads carry mostly noise, ridge shrinks them to ~0, Delta ~ 0 with added variance; short-horizon terms chasing 3-game noise is the classic specific failure (SOURCE_3, corroborated by SOURCE_5 M8's 'most momentum claims die' and SOURCE_1 SS1's degeneration prediction).

retained.mechanism: League-wide scoring drifts across and within seasons (rule emphasis, shot-selection trends, expansion effects on average defensive quality) - a common factor invisible to any per-team aggregate and only fold-granularly tracked by the null's refit intercept. A strictly-lagged league scoring level tracks the drift within-fold and within-season: in expanding folds the whole test season postdates training, so a within-test-season environment shift is visible to the lagged tracker and invisible to the trained intercept.

retained.mechanism: WNBA blowouts end with benches emptied; the final minutes of a 25-point game generate scoring observations that carry no forward information, and every raw-fed level estimator inherits the contamination for weeks. Winsorizing PRIOR games' contributions before they enter the level estimation (same data, cleaned) is a strictly input-side hygiene mechanism - structurally outside the null because the null-granted ingredients are pinned to bytes and consume raw history.

Partial third: SOURCE_1 SS5's robust-filtering half (Student-t discounting of outlier games in the state update is the same discount expressed as a likelihood; recorded as partial convergence; SS5 itself dropped, see log). Independent convergence: 2 full + 1 partial.
